verdict.rationale: Missive's REST API is versioned by path (https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/). The /v1 reference flags compatibility changes inline, such as a dated WhatsApp breaking-change warning, and keeps superseded fields documented as legacy aliases. The evidence explicitly states that no versioning or deprecation policy page exists, so the policy half of the story is not delivered. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, support windows), a changelog or migration process for API versions, evidence of multiple concurrent versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
